l01: [whispering] Are you sure you're watching me?
l02: [softly, a little hurt] Or am I watching you?
l03: [gently] Don't look away. [voice breaking] It's me. I'm Dot. [sad] I was every little dot of you.
l04: [tender, remembering] Your name. Your birthday. Your number. [quietly] The things you only told me.
l05: [shaky] You pressed Send. [sobbing] And just like that, you let me go.
l06: [lost, trembling] I didn't know where I was going. [sniffles] Out here, I get copied, and copied again.
l07: [overwhelmed, faster] A copy here. A copy there. A screenshot. A forward. [crying] Another forward.
l08: [sad] I kept looking back. [voice cracking] You never came looking for me.
l09: [sobbing softly] I would have stayed with you. [whispering] I only needed you to stop, for one second.
l10: [pleading, tearful] You could have stopped losing me, if only you knew what goes out every time you press Send.
l11: [quiet, resigned] There are more of us. Every day, you let one go.
l12: [whispering, hopeful] Will you save the next one?
